title: Simple Coin Shops resource pack
description: Official texture pack for Simple Coin Shops - Adds beautiful custom gold coin textures to Moto Coins. Works seamlessly with the economy mod!
body:
# 🪙 Moto Coin Resource Pack

**Official texture pack for the Simple Coin Shops mod**

This resource pack adds a custom gold coin texture for Moto Coins used in the Simple Coin Shops economy mod. Transform boring paper items into beautiful, shiny coins!

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎨 **Custom Gold Coin Texture** - Beautiful, detailed coin design
- 🔧 **Seamless Integration** - Works automatically with Simple Coin Shops mod
- 📦 **Lightweight** - Minimal file size, no performance impact
- 🎮 **Plug & Play** - Just install and enjoy!

---

## 📋 Requirements

### Required
- **Minecraft**: 1.21.1
- **Simple Coin Shops Mod**: Required for functionality

### Compatible With
- ✅ Fabric Loader
- ✅ Multiplayer Servers
- ✅ Single Player
- ✅ Can be used as server resource pack

---

## 🎮 Installation

### For Players (Client-Side)

1. Download the resource pack
2. Open Minecraft
3. Go to **Options** → **Resource Packs**
4. Click **Open Pack Folder**
5. Move the downloaded `.zip` file into this folder (**DO NOT UNZIP**)
6. Go back to Minecraft and activate the pack
7. Click **Done**

That's it! Your Moto Coins will now have custom textures.

### For Server Owners

#### Method 1: Server Resource Pack (Recommended)

1. Upload the resource pack to a file host (e.g., Dropbox, Google Drive, or your own web server)
2. Get the **direct download URL** (must end in `.zip`)
3. Generate the SHA1 hash:
   ```bash
   # Linux/Mac
   sha1sum Moto_Coin_Resourcepack.zip
   
   # Windows PowerShell
   Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA1 Moto_Coin_Resourcepack.zip
   ```
4. Edit your `server.properties`:
   ```properties
   resource-pack=https://your-url.com/Moto_Coin_Resourcepack.zip
   resource-pack-sha1=YOUR_SHA1_HASH_HERE
   require-resource-pack=true
   resource-pack-prompt=Please accept the Moto Coin resource pack for the best experience!
   ```
5. Restart your server

All players will automatically receive the resource pack when they join!

#### Method 2: Optional Client-Side
Simply share the download link with your players and let them install it manually.

---

## 🔍 What It Does

This resource pack modifies the **Paper** item to display a custom texture when it has `CustomModelData: 1`.

The Simple Coin Shops mod automatically sets this data on Moto Coins, so:
- **With this pack**: Moto Coins display as beautiful gold coins 🪙
- **Without this pack**: Moto Coins look like regular paper (but still work!)

---

## 🎨 Technical Details

- **Pack Format**: 34 (Minecraft 1.21.1)
- **Modified Item**: `minecraft:paper`
- **CustomModelData Value**: `1`
- **Files Included**:
  - `assets/minecraft/models/item/paper.json` - Model override
  - `assets/minecraft/models/item/moto_coin.json` - Coin model
  - `assets/minecraft/textures/item/moto_coin.png` - Coin texture

### For Developers

Want to integrate this into the mod directly? 
Check out the integration guide in the download!

---

## 📷 Screenshots

*The custom Moto Coin texture transforms paper items into shiny gold coins!*

---

## ⚙️ Customization

### Want to create your own coin design?

1. Unzip the resource pack
2. Replace `assets/minecraft/textures/item/moto_coin.png` with your own 16x16 PNG texture
3. Rezip the folder (make sure `pack.mcmeta` stays at the root level)
4. Install your custom version

### Tips for Custom Textures:
- Use 16x16 pixel resolution (or multiples for HD)
- PNG format with transparency support
- Keep the design clear and recognizable
- Test in-game to ensure it looks good in inventories and on the ground

---

## 📝 FAQ

**Q: Do I need this resource pack?**
A: No, the Simple Coin Shops mod works without it. However, without this pack, coins will look like regular paper items.

**Q: Will this affect my other paper items?**
A: No! Only items with CustomModelData=1 (Moto Coins) are affected. Regular paper items remain unchanged.

**Q: Can I use this on a server?**
A: Yes! Use the server resource pack feature to automatically push it to all players.

**Q: Does this work with other mods?**
A: Yes, it's compatible with most mods. It only modifies the paper item's appearance when specific data is set.

**Q: Can I modify the texture?**
A: Absolutely! See the Customization section above.

**Q: What if the texture doesn't show?**
A: Make sure:
- The resource pack is enabled and loaded
- You're using Minecraft 1.21.1
- The Simple Coin Shops mod is installed
- The pack is above "Default" in your resource pack list
